title: Computation Standard for the Reopened Hearing Date — Unemployment Insurance Appeals
content:
When the appeals office grants an appellant's timely reopening request on a dismissed appeal under Unemployment Insurance Appeals, it marks the request granted, sets the reopened hearing by telephone, mails the hearing notice today and notifies every interested party of the docket; the reopened-setting notice period is the number of calendar days from today, the day the notice is mailed, to the reopened hearing date. The reopened hearing date is the date that falls the reopened-setting window's number of calendar days after the day the reopened-setting clock starts. The reopened-setting clock starts on the date the reopening request was received. The reopened-setting window is the docket's reschedule window days. When the reopened hearing date found this way is fewer than the docket's notice minimum days after today, the reopened hearing is set the notice minimum days after today instead. A reopened hearing date that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday moves to the following Monday.

## The computation in order

| Point | Quantity | How it is fixed |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | clock start | the date the reopening request was received, as recorded on the request |
| 2 | date found | the clock start moved later by the docket's reschedule window days (calendar days) |
| 3 | notice minimum | if the date found is fewer than the docket's notice minimum days after today — or on or before today — the date becomes the notice minimum days after today; otherwise the date found stands (the later of the two) |
| 4 | weekend | a Saturday moves 2 days and a Sunday 1 day, to the following Monday |
| 5 | notice period | calendar days from today (day 0) to the date from point 4 |

The notice minimum is applied before the weekend rule; the notice period is counted from today, the day the notice is mailed.

## Worked computations (hypothetical inputs; today is Wednesday 15 April 2026; notice minimum 7 days)

- **Window 14 days; request received Thursday 9 April.** Date found: Thursday 23 April, 8 days after today — not fewer than 7, so it stands; a weekday. Notice period: **8 days**.
- **Window 14 days; request received Friday 20 March.** Date found: Friday 3 April, 12 days before today — fewer than 7 days after today, so the hearing is set 7 days after today, Wednesday 22 April. Notice period: **7 days**.
- **Window 21 days; request received Friday 10 April.** Date found: Friday 1 May, 16 days after today; it stands. Notice period: **16 days**.
